From the photographic archive

Bubba Oasis

44-48 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UR

Bar and café

A moment on the high street

What the photograph records

The former Bubba Oasis venue at 44-48 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UR, photographed on 3 April 2026 after closure. The pale blue frontage retains its Clapham's Clubhouse awning, with a Forge property agency board above the entrance.

Photographed
3 April 2026
Recorded state
Vacant when photographed
Business type
Bar and café

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 29 September 2025 Reported · unconfirmed

    Bubba Oasis: closure reported

    A Best of Clapham community post, dated 29 September 2025 by the project owner, reported that Bubba Oasis had closed. It described the venue as having opened in July 2023. The owner supplied the post's wording; we have not independently retrieved it. Neither the exact opening day nor the final trading day is established.

    Community closure report on Threads ↗
  2. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Bubba Oasis: closed by this date

    The project photographer confirms Bubba Oasis had ceased trading at this address by the time this photograph was taken. The exact closing date is unknown.
